Seed divider, Jack Heart: "maybe we want a differnet divider for job and seed", then "experiment/job:seed?". Address spelling: experiment/job:seed (sweep/wide:1; one-job experiment with seeds: sweep:1; one job and one seed: hanabi). Replaces the seed-1 spelling in the previous steer. Because macOS and Windows treat ":" badly in file names, ":" appears only in the address people type and read; on disk and in bucket keys the levels are nested folders or another safe spelling, never a name containing ":". Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md.
